{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# Note: the values are in format '1,234.56' or '0.00'
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99 — the documentation says there are 6 internal QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
completed_df = df[completed_mask]

# Now compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"QA orders detected: {qa_count}")
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")
print(f"Completed orders: {len(completed_df)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed:.2f}")

# Also check if any revenue is negative — just to be safe
min_revenue = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].min()
print(f"Minimum revenue in completed orders: {min_revenue}")"}
